zh: 一条尖顶外轮廓从两侧弧形笔画向上汇聚。
顶点下方中央大部分保持浅色开口空间。
左下方以一段短横向端部收束。
右下方以较粗的圆钝端部收束。
另有一条窄笔画穿过中央向下，并在下方弯曲。
来源元数据预期有四张图，但当前只有一张本地复核图；仍需获取另外三张来源视图。
en: A peaked outer contour rises from two curved side strokes.
The center is mostly a pale open field beneath the apex.
The lower left ends in a short horizontal terminal.
The lower right ends in a thicker rounded terminal.
A separate narrow stroke descends through the center and curls below.
Source metadata expects four images, but only one local review image is present; three source views still need retrieval.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
